summary:
Verified on 2026-11-08 (closing 2, pass 2). I took no new heavy captures. The model is unchanged: lisvel.glb md5 cea79e3b1f6cd4520bb5706485695202, the same as at b4cf39106, because GF-1 was reverted in 89112e613. The last Lisvel art commit is 788a0fbb1 (CW5 r3 Almanac refix). I viewed the three splashes, the Almanac portrait, three_lisvel_gorgewalk.png and the match75 x3 crop myself, and re-cropped the Almanac face and the Gorgewalk head with sips (scratchpad). The FK and splash-stat reports match their citations. Score 7.0 is confirmed, so Lisvel is NOT ON PAR. There is no blocker. All 4 majors are confirmed, and they all sit on card and skin surfaces. At the game camera she is about 7.5-8: a clean pale rounded wrap, a blue-grey tabard and a diagonal pale bow. Motion is about 7. Cards are about 5.5.

Sensitivity: no blocker.
- The wrap is rounded on every skin (11.9 cm, ruling 13).
- The base splash face shows a nose and a smile under a glass visor. The Almanac portrait shows a smiling face.
- The Almanac splash face is the closest case to the blank-mannequin rule. At 1600x900 it is a cream oval with a nostril dot, a faint smile and cheek planes. It does not read as horror, a hockey mask or a blank mannequin, so it stays a major watch item.
- In the Gorgewalk splash the face is hidden by the bow limb and the side-on pose. It is not a featureless face.

findings.title: Gorgewalk splash: the bow limb crosses the head, and the figure is a washed-out white, side-on cut-out
findings.what: She stands side-on at the right edge. The slate limb runs through the head at visor-to-chin height, so no face reads. The body is near-white (torso 151 against plate 138) with no rim and no shape value. The draw pose is hard to read.
findings.evidence:
- Splash: art/out/fighters/lisvel/lisvel_gorgewalk_splash.png
- 3x head re-crop: scratchpad gor3.png (sips crop 150x170 at 1150,110). The limb covers the face band and the crown is rounded.
- Stats: _harness/_reports/closing_lisvel_c2_splash_stats.txt
findings.gauge: A LoL skin splash is a painted composition with a clear face, a figure that owns the value range with a rim light, and a pose that tells the skin's theme.
findings.fix: Re-stage as the reviewer proposes: three-quarter facing with the face clear, the bow held low, cloth mid-tones at 110-140 with a cool rim, and the matte eroded by 1 px. Gate: the face reads at 25% size.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced visually. Not a sensitivity blocker: it is a head turned away behind a prop, not a blank face. The major stands because it is a paid skin's main card.

findings.title: Base splash: vertical bow with the upper limb cropped, the hand on the upper limb, and the torso darker than the plate
findings.what: The brief's signature level bow is vertical. The upper limb leaves the frame at y=0. The bow hand (about y 180-260) sits well above the bow's midpoint (about y 390). The string crosses the left cheek and jaw. The torso is luma 90 against plate 98.
findings.evidence:
- Splash: art/out/fighters/lisvel/splash.png
- Head crop: _harness/_shots/closing_lisvel_c2_base_head.png
- Stats: _harness/_reports/closing_lisvel_c2_splash_stats.txt
- Brief: _design/fighters/lisvel.md §10
findings.gauge: A LoL base splash keeps the face clear, holds the signature weapon's full silhouette in frame, and lifts the champion off the background.
findings.fix: Stage the brief's victory hold: bow level across the frame with both caps in, the bow hand on the riser, the draw hand in a salute at the visor, a warm low key, a cool rim, and the figure at least 15 luma off the plate.
findings.verifierNote: Confirmed, with one small correction. The string crosses the cheek edge and jaw, not the mouth, and the nose and smile still read. The figure separates by hue and outline, but the value is inverted. The vertical bow and the crop alone keep this a major on the champion's main card.

findings.title: Gorgewalk's body is the base body; only the bow and quiver change
findings.what: Every body close-up (front, back, side, face, shoulders, legs, belt) matches the base. At the game camera the skin can only be told apart by the bow tone.
findings.evidence:
- Turnarounds: art/renders/fighters/lisvel/three_lisvel_gorgewalk.png against three_lisvel.png
- Brief: _design/fighters/lisvel.md §9 (Gorgewalk is a bow, rope and quiver skin by design)
findings.gauge: A LoL skin is identifiable across the screen by the body's palette and material story, not the weapon alone.
findings.fix: Paint the body, keeping the silhouette and accent places (ruling 1/7): a sand wrap with a dark break, a lichen-streaked tabard, a slate gorget and painted rope lashing. Gate: per-pixel dE of 16 or more against the base at the game camera, with the top band L* 70-85.
findings.verifierNote: I tried to refute this. The brief deliberately scopes Gorgewalk to the bow and quiver to protect top-band value, so this is design-by-brief, not an execution miss. But owner_rulings.md line 7 says skins change material and palette, and against the LoL gauge a weapon-only skin is below par. Major kept.

findings.title: Almanac splash: at use size the face reads as a pale oval with one dark dot
findings.what: The face (luma 161) matches the plate (161). At 1600x900 and at 25% size it is a cream oval under the visor with a nostril dot. The smile and cheek planes appear only at about 3x. The Almanac portrait reads alive with a smile, so the gap is the splash light.
findings.evidence:
- Splash: art/out/fighters/lisvel/lisvel_almanac_splash.png
- 3x re-crop: scratchpad alm_face3.png (smile visible only magnified)
- Quarter-size view: scratchpad alm_q.png (oval with dot)
- Earlier crop: _harness/_shots/closing_lisvel_c2_almanac_head.png
- Stats: closing_lisvel_c2_splash_stats.txt
findings.gauge: A LoL splash face carries readable features at display size, with value contrast against the background.
findings.fix: Add a raking warm key from above-left, deepen the ink at the lid line and the mouth corners, and drop the sky behind the head by about 25 luma. Gate: face sd 40 or more, and the mouth readable at 50%.
findings.verifierNote: Not raised to a blocker. The face has a nose, cheek form and a faint smile, and the same skin's portrait is clearly alive. It does not read as horror or a hockey mask. It stays the sensitivity watch item.

findings.title: Auto-attacks whip the bow tip about 1.9 m in the first two frames
findings.what: The tip steps are 109+80 cm (attack1) and 123+92 cm (attack2) in f0-f1, with no anticipation.
findings.gauge: LoL marksman attacks read as a short raise-and-draw.
findings.fix: Ease f0-f3 with a peak tip speed of 40 cm per frame or less. Keep the impact at f8.

findings.title: Idle has little life
findings.what: In the 3 s idle the hips move 1.6 cm and the tip about 3.7 cm. Every tip step reads 0.
findings.gauge: LoL idles carry breath, a weight shift and a fidget.
findings.fix: Add a 3-4 cm weight shift, chest breath, and a once-per-loop string touch with a horizon look.

findings.title: Dash starts at the apex with no takeoff
findings.what: f0 hips are at 1.22 m against idle 0.94, with the tip 43 cm off idle. The takeoff is left to the crossfade.
findings.gauge: LoL dashes show a readable push-off.
findings.fix: Key a crouch-and-push over f0-f2 and shorten the apex hold.

findings.title: Channel clip is frozen and starts 172 cm off idle
findings.what: All 40 frames are identical. It is also recall's fallback.
findings.gauge: LoL channel and hold poses breathe.
findings.fix: Lead in from the guard pose, then loop a held draw with breath and a string tremble.

findings.title: Team accent nearly invisible at the game camera
findings.what: The bow-cap accent is about 0.3% of the figure and barely tints in the match frame. Team reads from the ring and the health bar.
findings.gauge: LoL relies on the ring and the bars too, so this is minor.
findings.fix: Brighten the cap accent within the 2-3% accent budget.
findings.verifierNote: The x3 crop shows faint cap tints. Minor is correct.
